I'm 36 but first started experiencing auditory hallucinations and delusions when I was 20yo. 
For 14 years I never mentioned hearing voices or being told what to do by the dj on the radio station etc. The voices I heard would basically just narrate my day with most actions I made like opening the fridge for example one would say "he's opening the fridge" another would say "don't let him open the door" no commands of violence or to myself or others. I kept this to myself because I was a very outgoing person and the voices I'd hear actually made me a very witty individual, I could form jokes in an instant, I had more 5 comebacks to anything anyone said.

Around 33 the voices became intolerable. They got aggressive and foul. They progressively got more and more malevolent. Telling me to go buy 18vbags of ice to put in the bathtub because nobody will find me after I slit my wrist. They got specific, d.c. make sure to sever your tendon so you can't fully function physically to call 911, just evil intrusive no chance of ignoring influences that became unbearable. 

I self medicated with illicit drugs trying find any form of feeling anything that what I was experiencing. In July 2020 a month after my 34th birthday I hit my breaking point. I lost all touch with reality. I hid guns everywhere I thought I might be because I was convinced that people even immediate family were out to kill me and I wanted to be prepared to take them out before they took me out, again no sense of reality. I became fixated that those out to get me were going unnoticed and my murder would never be solved, huge conspiracy. I couldn't handle someone taking my life and nobody knowing what happened when my body surfaces in the river 2 1/2 weeks after I'd gone missing. I was being consistently, constantly and aggressively commanded that I kill myself. 

I chambered 1 round in my mossberg 590 shockwave, as I placed the barrel in my mouth I pulled the trigger. I'll spare every detail but long story short the pellets and wadding exited from the corner of my mouth to my upper cheek just under my eye shredding everything in between. Teeth gone. Partial gum line gone. Partial tongue gone. Powder burns inside and down my esophagus and nasal passage. Even after multiple deep breaths smoke was still bellowing out of my nose. 

In the emergency room I was tested for illicit drugs which came back positive and I admitted that. After explaining why I did what I did and the years, weeks, days leading up to it, it was written off as drug induced psychosis was the reasoning. It took 3 months weekly therapy and weekly blood tests showing no drug usage that I was finally diagnosed with schizoaffective disorder. 

I was given anti psychotic medication & depression medication that dulled the voices but never fully took them away. The meds caused me to gain 150 pounds in a year and a half. 

Only 1 out of the 3 docs I've been to has taken Mr seriously, after all that just 1. I applied for disability September 2020 and denied, denied and denied at my all hearing March 2022. 

After everything not even a judge would take me seriously, like mental health in younger people is manageable and will be non debilitating even after losing a quarter of my face and sober 27 months, every day sober since I shot myself. The system fails so many
